name: io.github.tethlo/mcp-for-zammad
title: Tethlo MCP server for Zammad (unofficial)
description: Unofficial. Zammad helpdesk for AI agents: tickets, queue overview, notes, replies.

environmentVariables.name: ZAMMAD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Zammad address, e.g. https://support.example.com. In remote mode this is a server setting.

environmentVariables.name: ZAMMAD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Zammad access token (Profile > Token Access, permission ticket.agent).
